scriptsDescriptions.dev: Start Next.js dev server with hot reload on http://localhost:3000
scriptsDescriptions.build: Production build — runs TypeScript type-check, then emits `.next/`
scriptsDescriptions.start: Serve the production build (run `npm run build` first)
scriptsDescriptions.test: Vitest unit/component tests in watch mode
scriptsDescriptions.test:coverage: Vitest + v8 coverage report (thresholds: lines 90 / statements 87 / functions 89 / branches 78)
scriptsDescriptions.e2e: Playwright functional E2E (smoke + app nav + a11y), headless — the CI suite
scriptsDescriptions.e2e:smoke: Standalone smoke driver (scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs): seeds a project, walks every view, fails on any console/page error. Needs a running server
scriptsDescriptions.e2e:visual: Playwright visual-regression snapshots (opt-in; baselines are per-platform — generate CI's in the Linux container)
scriptsDescriptions.e2e:visual:update: Regenerate visual snapshot baselines for the current platform
scriptsDescriptions.docs:scripts: Regenerate AUTO-GENERATED scripts tables in repo docs from `package.json`
scriptsDescriptions.docs:scripts:check: Verify AUTO-GENERATED scripts tables are in sync; exit non-zero on drift (CI mode)
scriptsDescriptions.dup:check: Report code duplication in `src/` via jscpd (Phase 1 tech-debt baseline)
scriptsDescriptions.size:check: Fail if a src file exceeds 800 lines or grows past its baselined size (ratchet)
